title: Admin Panel
health_intro: Live status of each subsystem this server depends on. Probes run on demand.
health_public_note: Uptime monitors can poll GET /api/health for a simple 200/503 liveness check.
settings_intro: Server-wide runtime settings. Changes take effect immediately — no restart needed.
rate_limits_intro: Per-scope sliding-window limits. Limit = max attempts allowed, Interval = window length in seconds. Login + register are IP-keyed; API write + attachment upload are user-keyed.
smtp_password_set: Password is set — leave blank to keep
server_description_hint: Free-form text shown on the login / landing page. Up to 2000 characters.
accent_color_hint: Hex value, e.g. #22d3ee. Leave empty to use the built-in theme accent.
registration_enabled_hint: When off, the signup form is hidden and direct registration is rejected.
default_attachment_retention_hint: Empty = retain forever. Each community can override.
email_test_intro: Sends a plain-text email through the configured SMTP stack. Useful right after editing transport config.
users_intro: Browse and manage every account on this server. Click any row for details.
user_force_delete_intro: Immediately anonymises this account — skips the 7-day grace window. Authored messages stay; the author becomes "Deleted user".
user_disable_two_factor_message: Use this only to recover a locked-out user. Their TOTP secret and recovery codes are deleted; they can sign in with just their password and re-enroll.
communities_intro: Every community on this server. Use search to filter by name or identifier.
community_delete_intro: This permanently removes the community, every channel, every message, every membership. There is no undo.
server_description_placeholder: What is this server for? Shown on the login page.
setup_subtitle: Five quick steps to get your server humming.
setup_community_intro: Create a default community for your members. You can skip this and do it later.
setup_community_private_hint: Invite-only; hidden from the public list.
setup_registration_intro: Decide whether anyone can sign up, or only invited users.
setup_registration_open_hint: Anyone with the URL can sign up.
setup_registration_closed_hint: Sign-up form hidden — invite links + admin-created accounts only.
setup_mailer_intro: Configure SMTP so password resets and invite emails deliver, then send yourself a test.
setup_mailer_ok: Test email sent — check your inbox (and spam folder).
setup_mailer_fail: Could not send. Check SMTP host and credentials above.
setup_mailer_skip_hint: It's OK to skip — you can configure SMTP later in Admin → Settings → Email.
setup_done_body: Click Finish to enter Tyto. You can change any of these settings from Admin → Settings.
webhooks_intro: Outbound webhooks. When a trigger fires, the server POSTs a signed JSON payload to the configured URL.
webhooks_empty: No webhooks configured. Create one to get started.
webhook_delete_intro: This permanently removes the webhook and all its delivery history. There is no undo.
webhook_trigger_message_created_desc: Fires when a new message is posted in a channel.
webhook_trigger_message_replied_desc: Fires when a reply is added to a thread.
webhook_trigger_reaction_added_desc: Fires when a reaction is added to a message.
webhook_trigger_moderation_action_desc: Fires when a moderation action is taken (warn, timeout, ban).
webhook_regen_warning: The old secret stops working immediately. Update your receiver before clicking Regenerate.
webhook_reenable_body: This webhook was disabled. Re-enabling it will start sending events again.
webhook_reenable_replay_prompt: There are {{count}} pending/failed deliveries from when it was inactive. Replay them?
webhook_secret_warning: Store this now — it won't be shown again.
audit_intro: Append-only record of admin-panel actions. Read-only — review who did what.
disk_purge_hint: Emergency valve: when free disk space drops below the trigger, the oldest eligible attachments are deleted until the target is restored. Pinned messages, recent files and (by default) direct messages are protected.
disk_purge_trigger_hint: Run the purge when free space falls below this percentage. 0 disables it.
disk_purge_target_hint: Purge until free space reaches this percentage. Must be greater than the trigger.
disk_purge_min_age_hint: Attachments younger than this are never purged, even if the target cannot be reached.
disk_purge_include_dms_hint: Off = attachments in direct messages are never purged.
auto_timeout_progressive_hint: Repeat offences escalate the timeout: 1x, then 3x, then 10x the base duration, capped by the maximum below.
auto_timeout_hits_hint: Number of infractions within the window that triggers a timeout.
auto_timeout_window_hint: Rolling window in which infractions are counted.
auto_timeout_duration_hint: Length of the first auto-issued timeout.
auto_timeout_reset_hint: How long without an infraction before the hit count resets.
auto_timeout_max_hint: Cap for progressive escalation; the timeout will never exceed this.
ip_reputation_enabled_hint: When enabled, each registration sends the registrant's IP address and an MD5 hash of their email (never the raw address) to StopForumSpam, a third-party anti-spam database. Disclose this in your privacy policy. See tyto.chat/docs/anti-spam.
ip_reputation_confidence_min_hint: Block only when StopForumSpam's confidence score is at or above this value (0–100). Higher = fewer false positives.
ip_reputation_allowlist_hint: One entry per line: an email address, @domain.com, an IP address, or a CIDR range. Matching registrants are never checked.
ip_reputation_appeal_contact_hint: Shown to blocked registrants ("contact …"). Leave empty to show a generic message only.
ip_reputation_endpoint_hint: Default keeps queries on StopForumSpam's EU-boundary host.
validate_emails_hint: Requires users to confirm their email before they can log in.
invitation_expiry_hours_hint: How long admin-issued account invitations stay valid.
expiry_minutes_hint: How long the one-time code remains valid after issue.
digest_hour_hint: Hour of day (0–23, UTC) when daily digest emails are dispatched.
media_token_ttl_hint: How long signed attachment URLs remain valid.
emoji_token_ttl_hint: How long signed community emoji URLs remain valid. Can be longer since emoji rarely change.
default_bot_hint: Used for system messages when a role has no bot assigned.
welcome_bot_hint: Posts welcome messages. Falls back to the default bot when unset.
auto_moderator_bot_hint: Issues automatic timeouts. Falls back to the default bot when unset.
setup_item_defaultBot: Create and set a default bot
terms_url_hint: When set, new users must accept the terms to register.
privacy_url_hint: Shown on the sign-in and sign-up screens.
legal_contact_email_hint: Point of contact for legal and content notices (DSA).
minimum_age_hint: 0 disables the age gate. When set, users must provide a date of birth (not stored).
retention_cron_hint: Requires the scheduled command "php bin/console tyto:retention:purge" to run (e.g. daily via cron). 0 keeps data forever.
message_retention_days_hint: Redact the content of messages older than this many days. 0 keeps messages forever.
notification_retention_days_hint: Delete notifications older than this many days. 0 keeps them forever.
archived_channel_retention_days_hint: Archived channels are permanently deleted this many days after archiving. 0 keeps them forever.
require_consent_hint: New users must accept the Terms and Privacy Policy to register.
legal_doc_default_in_use: Empty — the shipped default document is shown to users.
legal_doc_placeholder: Markdown. Leave empty to use the shipped default.
catalogue_listing_hint: When on, this server may be listed in the public tyto server directory. Only a true/false flag is exposed.
setup_rail_note: Everything can be changed later in Admin → Settings.
setup_registration_antispam_hint: Open servers can screen sign-ups against a spam blocklist — see Admin → Settings → Moderation → Anti-spam registration check.
